symptom: Sparse selected image2 VFR QA sequence can repeat or substitute frames even when total image count matches, misleading subtitle-off frame labels.
root_cause: Original sparse PTS and image-output synchronization; checking only selected count did not establish exact n-to-image mapping.
fix: Preserved old QA; regenerated using select,setpts=N/(fps*TB),fps_mode=passthrough. Independently extracted n103 and verified pixel equality; reviewed corrected boards and ceil cue edges. Final media unchanged.
prevention: Use passthrough and continuous selected-frame PTS for QA image sequences; compare at least one independently extracted subtitle-off n frame. Use ceil(time*fps) for fractional first/off boundaries.
